newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fangda sets '96 interim dividend deadline.
newsitem.headline: Fangda sets '96 interim dividend deadline.

text.p: China's Shenzhen Fangda Co Ltd said on Monday it has set the deadline to register for its 1996 interim dividend at October 30.
In a notice in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times, the building materials producer said it will distribute four bonus shares for every 10 shares held in the first half of 1996.

Fangda said its A and B shares will go ex-dividend on October 31 and bonus shares distributed to holders of its B shares will be listed on November 5. Class A bonus shares will be floated on November 4, it added.

Fangda said in an interim report that its net profits soared 210.94 percent to 45.08 million yuan in the first half of 1996 from 14.50 million yuan in the same period of 1995, under Chinese accounting standards.
Using international accounting standards, it had net earnings of 44.02 million yuan in the January-June period of this year, said Fangda, without giving a comparative figure.
Fangda listed 18 million A shares in Shenzhen in April this year and 50 million B shares in Shenzhen last November.
